data.description: When a pane is opened by the herdr plugin it creates a pane title that starts with "Downtime" or "Manual", change this to include the local start time, in 24 hour clock and shorten the text, e.g. "Auto HH:MM" or "Man HH:MM"
data.title: dispatch start time in pane title

data.author: Map
data.comment:
{
  "comment": "## Clarifying Questions

Q1: What is the desired final format for each pane type?

The description gives examples 'Auto HH:MM' and 'Man HH:MM'. Should the format include:

(a) Just `Auto HH:MM` / `Man HH:MM` — ultra-short, no work item or skill info
(b) `Auto HH:MM <kind>` / `Man HH:MM <skill>` — preserves the dispatch kind/skill
(c) `Auto HH:MM <kind> <title> - WL-<id>` — full format with ID preserved

Note: the hydrator (WL-0MSOJLZD9004P8PI) matches panes by the trailing ' - WL-<id>' in the title. If the ID is dropped, the hydrator will break.

Q2: Should this new format still preserve the ID suffix (via truncatePaneTitlePreservingSuffix), or is a pure `Auto HH:MM` format acceptable (dropping ID and title)?

Q3: Should the time be the local machine time (timezone-aware) or UTC? The description says 'local start time'.",
  "author": "Map"
}

data.comment:
## Clarifying Questions

Q1: What is the desired final format for each pane type?

The description gives examples 'Auto HH:MM' and 'Man HH:MM'. Should the format include:

(a) Just 'Auto HH:MM' / 'Man HH:MM' — ultra-short, no work item or skill info
(b) 'Auto HH:MM <kind>' / 'Man HH:MM <skill>' — preserves the dispatch kind/skill  
(c) 'Auto HH:MM <kind> <title> - WL-<id>' — full format with ID preserved

Note: the hydrator (WL-0MSOJLZD9004P8PI) matches panes by the trailing ' - WL-<id>' in the title. If the ID is dropped, the hydrator will break.

Q2: Should this new format still preserve the ID suffix (via truncatePaneTitlePreservingSuffix), or is a pure 'Auto HH:MM' format acceptable (dropping ID and title)?

Q3: Should the time be the local machine time (timezone-aware) or UTC? The description says 'local start time'.
